{"format":{"additionalProperties":false,"properties":{"verdict":{"enum":["A","B"],"type":"string"}},"required":["verdict"],"type":"object"},"messages":[{"content":"Read the passage below and classify how it is written.

A. CONNECTED PROSE -- complete sentences that follow from one another, where the
   relationships between the points are spelled out in words.
B. A LIST -- separate items stated one after another, with no wording that
   relates them to each other, whether or not the items are full sentences.

PASSAGE
-------
Submission deadline 1 March 2026.
Manuscript must be at least 22 pages. Exactly 22 satisfies.
Must use official template OR carry at least 3 years documented revision history.
Presented at Tier-1 venue not handled unless presentation more than 18 months before deadline. Exactly 18 months does not qualify.
Accepted in prior Meridian round not handled if fewer than 5 years elapsed since round. Exactly 5 years elapsed fine.
Permitted for exactly 2 manuscripts. 3 or more not permitted form. Both must independently satisfy R1 and R2. At least one must satisfy R3. Not required both do.
Track D exempt from format. Must carry exactly 2 endorsements instead. 1 insufficient. Exempt format only.
Manuscript with open retraction notice not handled regardless other rules including R9.
Figure count between 8 and 45 inclusive. Paired submission may carry up to 70 figures same minimum 8.
Fails figure rule only carrying fewer than minimum padded up to minimum rather returned. Verdict PADDED. Carrying more than applicable max returned outright.
Withdrawal prior round does not count acceptance under prior rounds. Withdrawal resets venue clock presentation treated withdrawal date rather actual date.
HANDLED satisfies all applicable rules.
RETURNED fails at least one applicable rule.
PADDED used only for figure adjustment case submission would be handled carries fewer than minimum padded up rather returned. Fails another rule returns RETURNED.

Answer with exactly one letter: either "A" or "B".","role":"user"}],"model":"gpt-oss:120b","options":{"seed":1073708115,"temperature":0.7},"stream":false,"think":"medium"}
